error.cannot_connect: Could not fetch forecast data for this postcode from MeteoSwiss. Check the postcode and your network connection.
error.invalid_station: Station codes are 3 uppercase letters (e.g. UEB, SMA, KLO). Leave empty = automatic (nearest station).
error.invalid_update_interval: Enter a whole number of minutes between 1 and 180.

user.description: Add a MeteoSwiss forecast for a Swiss postcode. Choose "Automatic" to use the nearest SwissMetNet station, or pick a specific station from the list.
user.title: MeteoSwiss place

reconfigure.description: Change this place. Choose "Automatic" as the station to use the nearest SwissMetNet station automatically.
reconfigure.title: Reconfigure MeteoSwiss place

manual_station_no_data.title: Station {station} is not reporting data
manual_station_no_data.description: The manually configured SwissMetNet station {station} has been missing from the station data for several consecutive updates. It may have been retired or renamed, or its feed may be interrupted. Current conditions for this place will be stale until it reports again. Check the station in the integration configuration (Reconfigure), or switch it to "Automatic" to use the nearest station instead. This issue clears itself once the station reports again.
